events.name: Stuff Your Bass
events.description:
Forget subtle. Nov 20, the Ranchero Room turns into a full-blast EDM takeover and the bass is not asking permission — it's in your chest, your drink, your bones. Cabana Bass takes the decks and stitches together the hits you already scream in your car with low-end that rattles the walls.

This isn't background music — it's the whole night. Lights low, speakers loud, floor packed. One set bleeds into the next with zero filler, just drop after drop after drop.

Show up ready to move. Bring friends, bring energy, leave your inhibitions at the door — Azúcar's turning the bass up and there's no turning it back down.

10pm, Ranchero Room. Stuff Your Bass. You've been warned.

🗓️ Viernes 20 de noviembre — Show 10:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🔞 18+ · Cover $15

events.name: Rope Jam
events.description:
Rope has rhythm, tension, breath — and Rope Jam is where you learn to speak that language. Bobda Rigger takes over the Ranchero Room for a night built for curious hands and open minds: safety fundamentals, tying techniques, and real ties broken down step by step, whether you're brand new to the rope or already know your way around a knot.

This isn't a demo you watch from the back — it's a social. Bring a partner or find one in the room. Instructors circulate with hands-on help, adjusting your grip, your tension, your angles, making sure every tie is safe and every person feels steady. The Ranchero Room gets low light and good music, turning practice into something that actually feels sensual instead of clinical.

Complete beginners welcome, seasoned riggers welcome too — everybody's starting somewhere, and this room makes room for all of it. Come with questions, come with rope, come ready to learn something with your hands.

November 21st, 7pm. Azúcar's Ranchero Room. Every body welcome, every knot a conversation.

🗓️ Sábado 21 de noviembre — Show 7:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🔞 21+ · Cover Free

events.name: Drag Queen Kareoke
events.description:
Forget the karaoke bar you know. This one's got sequins, sass, and Beah Hazard running the mic like she owns it — because tonight, she does.

Here's the twist: you sign up, you sing your song — maybe it's flawless, maybe it's a glorious trainwreck, either way the Lounge is cheering you on. Scattered throughout the night, the queens take over for live performances that'll have you screaming louder than you did for your own song. Equal parts talent show, variety show, and group hug.

Come solo and leave with new friends. Come with your crew and watch each other crumble under the spotlight. Either way, grab a drink, grab the mic, and let Beah Hazard turn your Tuesday-brain karaoke pick into a main character moment.

Every body welcome, every voice encouraged — yes, even that one.

🗓️ Miércoles 25 de noviembre — Show 7:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🔞 21+ · Cover Free

events.name: Sip and Paint with ArtwithAubrey
events.description:
Forget blank canvases and pressure — this is sip-and-paint season, Azúcar style. Pull up a seat in the Ranchero Room while Art With Aubrey walks you through decorating your very own set of Christmas bulbs, one sip and one brushstroke at a time. No art degree required, just a little holiday chispa and a drink in hand.

Aubrey's got the instruction and inspiration covered, so whether you're painting a tiny masterpiece or something delightfully chaotic, you'll leave with ornaments nobody else has and a tree that actually looks like you. Glitter, color, a little sparkle in your glass — it's festive, it's forgiving, and it's made for laughing at your own art.

Come solo, bring your people, make it a date night — every bulb, every brushstroke, every body welcome. December 6th at 6pm, Ranchero Room. Come paint, sip, and deck your tree the Azúcar way.

🗓️ Domingo 6 de diciembre — Show 6:00 PM
📍 Azúcar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🔞 21+ · Cover $33
